title: Thanks for confirming
intro: Thank you for confirming Thank you for confirming that you’d like to stay in touch with Toynbee Hall and hear about our latest campaigns, news, and events. You can opt-out of these correspondences, or refine your preferences at any time, by emailing fundraising@toynbeehall.org.uk.
